guide.title: Guide to write a statement template for Planejamento Mensal
guide.task: Write a template for the monthly statement of one member in the Planejamento Mensal app. The app renders the statement as HTML and turns it into an A4 PDF and an image. The data (tables, amounts, dates) is generated by the app; the template sets colours, font, texts, which blocks appear, extra CSS and, optionally, a full layout that places the parts of the statement.
guide.answerHint: Answer with a single JSON object in this format, without comments. Leave out the fields you do not want to change; use null in advancedCss, advancedHtml or layoutHtml to not use them.
guide.ruleHtml: advancedHtml (replaces the standard header): only the tags {{tags}}; only the attributes {{attributes}}. Scripts, links, images and events are removed.
guide.ruleLayout: layoutHtml (replaces the whole statement body): the same tags plus {{tags}}; attributes {{attributes}}.
guide.ruleCss: advancedCss is added to the standard CSS (shown in the sample HTML below). A CSS with any of these is dropped whole: {{forbidden}}.
guide.ruleSizes: Maximum sizes in characters: advancedCss {{css}}, advancedHtml {{header}}, layoutHtml {{layout}}.
guide.rulePdf: The PDF is rendered by OpenHTMLtoPDF: CSS 2.1 with part of CSS 3. Do not use flexbox, grid, CSS variables, external fonts or JavaScript; prefer tables, floats, margins, borders and colours. A4 page with 16 mm × 14 mm margins.
guide.ruleBlocks: blocks lists the blocks shown, in order, without repeats, at least one: {{blocks}}.
guide.rulePlaceholders: In layoutHtml, each part of the statement comes in through its placeholder: {{placeholders}}. The order comes from the layout; a block missing from blocks stays empty; any other placeholder is refused.
guide.ruleVariables: Variables accepted in the texts, advancedHtml and layoutHtml: {{variables}}. Any other is refused.
guide.ruleTexts: texts holds the texts of each language ({{languages}}): header (title), footer, message (note block text), emailSubject, emailBody and whatsapp. Write each language in its own language.
guide.ruleHeader: With an empty advancedHtml the standard header uses the header text; with an empty layoutHtml the statement follows the order of blocks.
guide.ruleLogo: primaryColor and secondaryColor use the #RRGGBB format. The logo stays in the app: do not send the logo field.
guide.selectors: Classes and ids of the standard statement
guide.sample: HTML rendered today, with sample data
guide.sampleHint: This is the statement the current template renders with made-up data; it shows the standard CSS, the classes and the table structure.
guide.requestHint: (Describe here the style you want for the statement.)
